notes.99A.88: Mahaf ('He who sees behind him') and Aqen are the ferryman figures. Line 91: ḥkꜣ may be the god Heka, 'Magic', or 'a magician'.

nodes.text: Mahaf, wake Aqen, who is endowed with life!
Who are you, then, who comes?
